story.title: Trump Directs Contractors to Withhold Information from Congress
story.summary: President Trump has issued an executive order instructing federal contractors to consult with the White House before responding to inquiries from Congress. The order mandates that any communications deemed 'privileged' by the administration should be withheld from Congress. This move is seen as a response to anticipated oversight efforts from Democrats set to take control of Congress in January.

related_stories.summary: Israeli opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has condemned a series of arson attacks on Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank, labeling them as 'Jewish terrorism.' The attacks involved Israeli settlers setting fire to vehicles and properties in multiple locations. In response, Israeli authorities have initiated an investigation into the incidents.

related_stories.summary: Liverpool secured a dominant 4-0 victory over Manchester United at Anfield, capitalizing on Leny Yoro's red card just eight minutes into the match. This defeat marks a challenging start for Mauricio Pochettino in his debut as Manchester United manager, as the team faced early setbacks with two quick goals from Liverpool.

related_stories.title: Chuck Hubbard Wins North Carolina House Race Against Virginia Foxx
related_stories.summary: Democrat Chuck Hubbard has defeated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in a North Carolina House race following a recount. This victory marks a significant shift in a district that has been held by Foxx for 11 terms, contributing to the Democrats' largest majority in the House since 1992.

related_stories.title: Capture of Cartel Leader 'El Chapo Isidro' Sparks Violence in Sinaloa
related_stories.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as 'El Chapo Isidro' and one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives, was captured by Mexican special forces in Sinaloa during a military operation. Following his arrest, violence erupted in the region, resulting in at least 11 deaths, with reports of gunfire and chaos among civilians. The operation involved cooperation with US intelligence and included a shootout between security forces and armed members of his cartel.
